name: Patrick W. Atwater
office: Foothill Municipal Water District, Member, Board of Directors, Division 5

items.text: Patrick W. Atwater is a water program manager. He says he has nearly two decades of experience in water management and infrastructure financing, and leads an innovation program for a large water utility. He also says he helped build La Crescenta's first stormwater recharge bioswale. If elected, he says he will improve disaster coordination, speed up Altadena fire recovery, invest in local water supplies, and insist on accountability.
